fallbacks.colorSpace: Opaque sRGB HEX with termguicolors; indexed terminal conversion and user overrides need separate checks.
fallbacks.fonts: Neovim TUI uses the terminal font. Request ordinary italic for comments/keywords, retaining terminal ligature and fallback settings; no fonts installed.
fallbacks.radius: Neovim grids and terminal windows do not express component radius.
fallbacks.shadows: Opaque float surfaces and borders replace elevation; native window shadows belong to the terminal/compositor.
fallbacks.motion: No animation, cursor blink or scrolling settings are changed.
fallbacks.interaction: Normal, search, selection, cursor, diff, Treesitter captures and LSP diagnostics use native highlight groups. Keyboard mappings, cursor shapes and external plugins remain user configuration.
